primitives.name: Out-of-Bounds Pass Completion
primitives.verbatim_quote: No longer will throwing the ball out of bounds be substituted by teams for a kick, for a forward pass going out of bounds on the fly, whether it touches a man or not, is now ruled as an incompleted forward pass.
primitives.assumptions: Pass trajectory is deterministic within bounded kinematics; boundary interaction is binary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( P_{pass} \in \mathbb{R}^+ \) and \( B_{bounds} < 0 \), pass is incomplete.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Probability of pass completion conditioned on boundary event. GSE: State transition from active to halted play.
layer2.telemetry: Pass outcome classification and penalty assignment

primitives.name: Substitute Replacement Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The flocking of substitutes in the last period has been stopped and no re-substitution will be allowed except at the beginning of a period.
primitives.assumptions: Substitution is discrete and temporally constrained.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( R_{re} = 1 \) and \( T_{period} > t_{start} \), substitution invalid.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Temporal constraint on substitution events. GSE: Play state update with fixed substitution window.
layer2.telemetry: Substitution timing validation and state-lock enforcement

primitives.name: Fullback Penalty Regime
primitives.verbatim_quote: Running into the full-back is penalized 15 yards, but "roughing" the full-back is penalized 15 yards and disqualificatilon as well.
primitives.assumptions: Penalty magnitude is additive; disqualification is binary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( P_{rough} = 15 \) and \( D_{disq} = 1 \), fullback violation triggers disqualification.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Violation severity scoring. GSE: Discrete action state change with penalty accumulation.
layer2.telemetry: Violation type classification and penalty application
